clauses.raw: pchor checphedy qokedy lsheedy qokchdy r shedkedy qopshdy qopy
clauses.working_reading: Take the stone, with enclosure as a wearable protective amulet as the goal.
clauses.reduction: INSTRUCTION TAKE(S); GOAL(ENCLOSE(A), AS_AMULET(A), FOR_WEAR(A,W), FOR_PROTECTION(A,W)). The first ENCLOSE has the same operation denotation as C08, but GOAL quotes it and has no world-state effect.
clauses.source_relationship: Source opening TAKE plus later enclosure/wear and claimed protection, reordered into an explicit goal frame.

clauses.raw: olkeey rchs cheeb ols aiin skal dain cthal s aiin chky lal sam
clauses.working_reading: Regard the distinction: an image has the form of a bird kind, but a physical part, also from a bird body, remains material.
clauses.reduction: Declare representation and material-provenance schemas. OF(kind) under FORM describes depiction content; OF(body) under PHYSICAL_PART describes bodily provenance. These do not introduce the represented bird as an enclosed physical animal.
clauses.source_relationship: Analytical elaboration of the source's distinct depiction/material roles; not an assertion that this explanatory sentence occurs verbatim in Greek.

okeey.meaning: The argument retains its individual identity across the named assembly process. Same predicate for the engraving I and grape seed G; neither continued loose availability nor unchanged position is asserted.

keey.meaning: Conjoin the two adjacent assertions. A new whole-word synonym of y, openly counted.

dalkedy.meaning: Introduce the condition inside an attributed protection proposition. IF C THEN PROTECTS(A,W,Q), not the converse and not actual efficacy.

yteedy.meaning: The already specified two-member material group {G,P}; P is the physical part of the current E or H branch. This fixed group-reference macro is one new value and introduces no object.

qokeed.meaning: The existing assembly A is physically enclosed. This is a state predicate, not a second ENCLOSE action and not a goal quotation.

y.meaning: Conjoin two adjacent state predicates. Same logical conjunction as keey; the synonym is not inferred from spelling.

qokey.meaning: The existing assembly A is worn, with the wearer supplied by BY. This is a state predicate, not a new wearing action.

otedy.meaning: Bind the immediately following Person as the wearer argument of WORN_STATE.

cheodar.meaning: The implicit engraving argument retains its identity; this does not assert unchanged material composition, shape or position of every object.

cheey.meaning: The depiction argument is hosted on the physical carrier argument, with the same host relation as the parent engraving operation.

yched.meaning: Universally quantify the preceding invariant over states in the explicitly named ASSEMBLY interval of the finite instruction trace.

chockhey.meaning: Declare the preceding proposition as an invariant constraint on the instruction trace; no extra physical event.

sheol.meaning: The physical part is below the explicitly named carrier. The argument order is specified by production C13, not guessed separately at each occurrence.

lkeedy.meaning: The carrier S already introduced by the parent engraving instruction; an explicit new reference alias, not a new stone.

oteedy.meaning: Require that the following physical part retain the stated pose over the explicitly supplied time region. Does not create or place a part.

ched.meaning: The source bird kind of the already selected physical component P: E in the eagle branch, H in the hawk branch. This is a new branch-dependent reference constructor, not a constant eagle or a new choice.

keam.meaning: The suffix of the same finite instruction trace strictly after completion of the named assembly process, through that trace end; not all indefinitely possible future history.

clauses.working_reading: But the engraving persists, and the grape seed persists.
clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=parent C09 final attributed OTHER_EFFECTS_UNSPECIFIED assertion, following=AND(PERSISTS(I,assembly_interval),PERSISTS(G,assembly_interval))). The final source-section closure is not treated as another physical assertion. This is a new commentary relationship, not a claim that unspecified effects destroy objects.

clauses.working_reading: As regards the stone, the source protection claim is expressed conditionally: if that stone with the selected materials is enclosed and worn by the same wearer.
clauses.reduction: Topic S1=the inherited S. Construct ordered accompaniment WITH(S2,SELECTED_MATERIALS={G,P}) with S2=S1. Resolve A as the unique already planned assembly whose components are exactly {S2,G,P}; do not identify A with S2. Resolve W2=SAME(WEARER)=the inherited W. Append CLAIM(IF(ENCLOSED(A) AND WORN_BY(A,W2),PROTECTS(A,W2,Q))), Q=the unchanged previous-ailment chapter reference. The two explicit STONE tokens remain S; the first is a topic and the second a physical member. The implicit claim bearer A and ailment argument Q are a new construction, not contained in the STONE denotation. No physical enclosure, wearing or health mutation occurs in this clause.

clauses.working_reading: Require that the unchanged engraving remain hosted on the stone throughout assembly.
clauses.reduction: Resolve the implicit depiction argument to I from THE_ENGRAVING in C10; require THROUGHOUT(assembly_interval,UNCHANGED_IDENTITY(I) AND HOSTED_BY(I,S)). ASSEMBLY is exactly the original gathering-and-enclosing process, with no new shorter interval. Postposed REQUIRE declares the invariant before the joint plan is executed.

clauses.working_reading: But keep the wing-tip from the selected bird kind under that same carrier after assembly.
clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=C12 depiction-host invariant, following=KEEP(P,UNDER(P,S),AFTER(assembly_interval))). SAME(CARRIER_REFERENCE)=S. Evaluate the inherited WING_TIP_OF on SELECTED_BIRD_KIND; resolve its unique already available branch part to P, introducing no extra part. ASSEMBLY denotes the very same process as C12. AFTER begins only after gathering/enclosure completes, so this does not assert that loose P was already below S before placement.

binary_policy.inventory: L is exactly the88-entry union above, with each full tag and denotation unchanged. No meaning or atom is borrowed from powder, Galen, transport, weaving or music.
binary_policy.analysis_of_a_raw_group: For every exact raw group w, offer [w] when w is a key in L. Also offer every ordered pair [u,v] of nonempty exact keys of L for which literal concatenation u+v equals w. Include every admissible pair, even when w already has an atomic value. Retain duplicate-tag derivations with their different lexical/source ownership. Do not privilege saiin or qokeedy.
binary_policy.limits: At most2 lexical terminals per written group. No recursive re-splitting of a chosen component, no three-terminal analysis, no zero code, no character replacement/deletion, no alias generation, no crossing or erasing an observed raw space, no new pause/line-start/previous-dy selector. Components may come from the entire frozen88-entry inventory in either whole unit; this shared choice is fixed in advance.
binary_policy.writer_equivalent: A lexical-terminal stream may pack one terminal or two consecutive terminals into a written group, preserving exact concatenation and order. Packing is an explicit finite ambiguity, not a deterministic prediction of where the manuscript must have a space. It does not identify EVA glyphs as sounds or prove the proposed units to be historical morphemes.
binary_policy.complete_parse: Feed every resulting terminal-tag stream to the unchanged9 original and4 extension construction schemas for its complete inherited unit; retain their original references, types, scopes and all semantic values. A full analysis must own every raw character and every group, consume every terminal once and produce the full declared content, including both original material alternatives and the extension's attributed-claim rival. Preserve all complete analyses and their distinct meanings; no best-parse choice by desired content.
binary_policy.what_changes: The old assumption that every written group contributes exactly one lexical terminal is replaced by this single atomic-or-binary frontend. Atomic dictionary entries, their denotations and the construction patterns over terminals stay fixed. A whole written form may now have a lexicalized atomic analysis and a distinct compositional analysis. This is a substantive new representation, not an unchanged-code rerun or retrospective correction of1023/492.
binary_policy.what_does_not_follow: A prefix need not preserve an operation, and a substring is not automatically a constituent. Only full registered lexical components with exact concatenation become alternatives; surviving complete syntax can constrain them. Even a unique parse under these authored schemas does not establish historical syntax or word meanings.
